english:
Casting a <solar Solar /> Super grants <solar Radiant /> to you and allies within 15 meters.

Super Damage increases with each ally granted Radiant, counting yourself: 6%|?%|?%|?%|?%|15?%.

Well of Radiance casters keep the bonus for 5 seconds.

source.text:
On Solar Super Cast:
Caster and Allies within 15 meters are granted Radiant.
Grants an Ally-Amount based Increased Super Damage.
Caster counts as an ally. 

Increased Super Damage:
6% | ?% | ?% | ?% | ?% | 15?%
Well of Radiance Caster benefits for 5 seconds.
